reports.title: Uber Announces Results for Third Quarter 2026

guidance.heading: Outlook for Q4 2026
section: •Gross Bookings of $63.25 billion to $65.25 billion, representing growth of 18% to 22% YoY on a constant-currency basis.
◦Our outlook assumes a roughly 1 percentage-point currency headwind to total reported YoY growth.
•Non-GAAP EPS of $0.95 to $0.99, representing growth of 34% to 39% YoY.
◦Our outlook translates to Adjusted EBITDA of $3.13 billion to $3.23 billion.
